Hi all —

Adding a few technical clarifications from the product/ops perspective:

- Tested cluster size & topology: our integration tests and two customer pilots validated up to 32 GPU nodes in single-tenant mode; for multi-team scenarios we recommend a hub-and-spoke topology with one control plane per tenant and shared storage behind a narrow API gateway. That minimizes blast radius while allowing batching efficiency.

- Snapshot & restore: we recommend block-level snapshots taken every 6 hours for active models and daily full snapshots. Restores should be validated in a staging VLAN first; our runbook includes a "restore-validate" checklist.

- Patch distribution: for air-gapped sites we produce signed patch bundles (tar.gz) with an attached SHA256-signed manifest. Operators import the bundle through an airlock host which verifies signatures. We supply automation scripts to validate the manifest and to perform a dry-run.

- Operator roles: short matrix below:
  - Platform Admin: full cluster lifecycle, patch approvals, license management.
  - Operator: deploy/scale nodes, runbackups, run smoke tests.
  - Auditor: read-only access to audit logs and SBOM exports.

- SBOM: we provide SPDX v2.2 JSON and a human-readable PDF sample; supply-chain attestations are available through our build pipeline logs.

I've attached a network-zone-template.vsdx to help Horizon map their internal VLANs and firewall rules to the operator runbook.

Will join the workshop to walk the technical steps if scheduled.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
